zones.title: Context
zones.body: Session and market rows: the return number and the language come from the market.

zones.title: Return UUI
zones.body: Hex payload within 64 bytes, Refer-To string, stored on the session for the lookup endpoint.

panels.title: AR-14 Build handoff
panels.body: The one place that knows the contact-center UUI format. Hex budget 64 bytes, ASCII 128. The correlation ID is never truncated; the case ID is dropped first and logged.
